title: Protein Extraction from Cell Pallets
author: Jacob Waldbauer
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.b4btqsnn
materials: make 1M DTT stock solution in LC/MS water.

steps.title: Prepare 1X LDS Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare 40mL of 1X LDS buffer by combining the specified reagents.

steps.title: Reduce Protein Samples
steps.instruction: Add 200~500uL of 10mM DTT in 1X LDS buffer to the cell pellet tube.

steps.title: Heat Samples
steps.instruction: Heat the sample at 95ºC for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Cool Samples and Prepare IAM
steps.instruction: Cool the sample down to room temperature and prepare a 0.5M iodoacetamide (IAM) stock solution.

steps.title: Alkylate Proteins
steps.instruction: Add IAM to the sample to a final concentration of 50mM/60mM and incubate in the dark for 30-60 minutes.

steps.title: Final Reduction
steps.instruction: Add DTT to the sample to a final concentration of 50mM/60mM to prepare the sample for FASP.
